final: WITH m AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS chan, e.fillcount AS fc FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark), g AS (SELECT chan, AVG(fc) AS avgfill, COUNT(*) AS gcnt FROM m GROUP BY chan), t AS (SELECT SUM(gcnt) AS total FROM g) SELECT g.chan, g.avgfill, g.gcnt, CAST(g.gcnt AS REAL) / t.total FROM g CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL
